ko.label: 은은한 양송이 풍미
ko.description: 양송이를 먹었어. 은은한 향과 순한 맛이 좋았어.

en.label: subtle button mushroom flavor
en.description: I ate button mushrooms. Their subtle aroma and mild flavor were nice.

ko.label: 표고의 깊은 감칠맛
ko.description: 향이 진한 표고를 먹었어. 감칠맛이 정말 좋았지.

en.label: rich shiitake umami
en.description: I ate some fragrant shiitake. The savory flavor was really good.

ko.label: 느타리의 은은한 감칠맛
ko.description: 느타리는 부드럽고 은근히 맛있었어. 꽤 괜찮았지.

en.label: subtle oyster mushroom umami
en.description: The oyster mushrooms were soft and subtly tasty. Quite nice, really.

ko.label: 새송이의 탱글한 식감
ko.description: 새송이를 먹었어. 두툼한 살을 씹는 느낌이 좋았어.

en.label: springy king oyster mushrooms
en.description: I ate king oyster mushrooms. I liked chewing their thick flesh.

ko.label: 아삭아삭한 팽이
ko.description: 팽이의 아삭한 줄기가 마음에 들었어. 씹는 맛이 좋았지.

en.label: crisp enoki
en.description: I liked the crisp enoki stems. They were nice to chew.

ko.label: 꼬들꼬들한 목이
ko.description: 목이를 먹었어. 꼬들꼬들하게 씹히는 느낌이 정말 좋았어.

en.label: chewy wood ear mushrooms
en.description: I ate wood ear mushrooms. Their chewy texture was really nice.

ko.label: 오독오독한 느티만가닥
ko.description: 느티만가닥이 은근히 고소했어. 오독하게 씹히는 것도 좋았지.

en.label: crunchy beech mushrooms
en.description: The beech mushrooms were subtly nutty. I liked their crunch, too.

ko.label: 잎새의 짙은 풍미
ko.description: 잎새버섯은 맛이 진하고 고소했어. 정말 맛있게 먹었지.

en.label: rich maitake flavor
en.description: The maitake had a rich, nutty flavor. I really enjoyed them.

ko.label: 노루궁뎅이의 부드러운 결
ko.description: 노루궁뎅이버섯의 부드러운 살이 좋았어. 은근한 단맛까지 마음에 들어.

en.label: tender lion's mane
en.description: I liked the tender flesh of the lion's mane mushroom. Its subtle sweetness was nice, too.

ko.label: 송이의 솔숲 향
ko.description: 정말 향긋한 송이를 먹었어. 입안에 퍼지는 솔향이 끝내줬지.

en.label: pine-scented matsutake
en.description: I ate some wonderfully fragrant matsutake. The pine aroma filling my mouth was fantastic.
